interface.rails.title: Syntax diagram:
interface.rails.description: Follow it like a railway track, left to right and top to bottom. Pills are words written exactly as shown; dashed boxes are slots you fill in; a detour below may be taken or skipped, and a loop back may be repeated.

agenda-cola.descripcion: On the left, the running task. On the right, the ready queue with tasks 1 and 2, from which the next one to come in leaves. Below, the suspended tasks, where the current one goes if it waits for something.

aguardar-pausa.descripcion: Two timelines. Task A works, pauses at Await while task B works, and continues when B hands it the result.

alcanzables.descripcion: The active frames point to an object, which points to another. A third object has no arrow reaching it and is marked as unreachable.

alias-copia.descripcion: a and alias point to object 1 with owner Ana and 3 books. Copiar creates object 2 with the same data, pointed to by copia. Afterwards object 1 has 5 books and object 2 has 9.

ambito-tareas.descripcion: The parent's line runs from top to bottom. At Tasks it spawns two children, Ana and Leo, that progress in parallel. Both join the parent again at EndTasks.

ambitos-anidados.descripcion: A large box for the process with the variable n, and inside it another for the If branch with the variable doble. From inside n is visible; from outside doble is not.

ampliaciones.descripcion: Three green arrows: from Integer to Real, from Character to String and from a subclass to its superclass. Below, in red, the conversions that never happen by themselves: Real to Integer, Boolean to number and number to text.

anatomia-diagnostico.descripcion: At the top, the diagnostic as data: code incompatibleTypesInAssignment, semantic class and error severity, span on line 2 and arguments expected Integer and found String. An arrow with the language template leads to the presented message.

arbol-precedencia.descripcion: The expression 2 + 3 * 4 is grouped as a tree with + at the root, 2 on the left and 3 * 4 on the right. The product reduces to 12 and the sum to 14.

archivo-capas.descripcion: DirCap leads with open to FileCap, which leads with readText to the contents "Comprar pan". Every step can end in Error(IoError).

arreglo-casillas.descripcion: Four boxes in a row with the values 7, 9, 6 and 8 and the indices 0, 1, 2 and 3 below. On the right, a fifth dashed, crossed-out box with index 4, which does not exist.

ausentes.descripcion: Four constructs that do not exist, each with its alternative: abstract classes versus interfaces, static members versus parameters, protected versus Public and Private, and exceptions versus Result.

bytes-utf8.descripcion: At the top, the three characters of año: a, ñ and o. Below, their four octets: 97 for a, 195 and 177 for ñ, and 111 for o.

cadena-caracter.descripcion: At the top, A between single quotes and between double quotes both lead to the Character type. Below, empty quotes and a two-letter text lead to the String type.
cadena-caracter.nota: The content decides, not the quotes

cajas-variables.descripcion: Three boxes in memory: libros and cuadernos, of type Integer, start empty; nombre, of type String, starts with "Leo". Then libros receives 3 and cuadernos receives 6, computed by reading libros.

caminos-valor.descripcion: A diagram with the condition puntos > 50. Along the true branch premio receives 10; along the false one it receives nothing. Both paths reach Write premio, which is marked as an error.

canal-cola.descripcion: A producer on the left sends values into a channel with two slots holding 20 and 10; a consumer on the right receives them in order.

capacidades-llaves.descripcion: On the left, the program with three capabilities: Console, FileCap and Clock. On the right, the host with the terminal, the disk and the time. Each capability is an arrow to its resource.

capas-motor.descripcion: A column of layers from top to bottom: text, lexical, syntax, semantics and intermediate representation. Two arrows leave the intermediate representation: virtual machine and native code.

cinta-efectos.descripcion: A tape with three numbered entries: output, file and clock, joined by arrows. Below, the note that they are chained and that replaying gives the same run.
cinta-efectos.encadenadas: every entry is chained to the previous one
cinta-efectos.reproducir: replaying the tape gives the same run

clase-objetos.descripcion: At the top, the class Punto with the attributes x and yy. Two arrows marked New lead to two objects: one with x = 3 and yy = 4, the other with x = 0 and yy = 7.

clases-diagnostico.descripcion: Four stages in a column, lexical, syntax, semantic and runtime, each with an example on the right. A red bar next to the first three marks that they are discovered before running.
clases-diagnostico.antes: Discovered before running: they prevent running
clases-diagnostico.nota: Warnings warn but still let the program run

clausura.titulo: Each closure with its own copy
clausura.descripcion: The call multiplicador produces two closures, doble and triple. Each carries its own copy of factor inside, 2 and 3 respectively.
clausura.nota: Captured copies travel with each function

coincidencia-larga.descripcion: At the top, x stuck to the arrow and the 1 splits into x, the assignment arrow and 1: an assignment. Below, with spaces, it splits into x, less than, minus and 1: a comparison.
coincidencia-larga.regla: The engine takes the longest possible piece.
coincidencia-larga.regla2: A space can change the pieces.

comentario.descripcion: Two program lines. In the first, what follows the two slashes is shaded and labelled comment. In the second, the two slashes are inside a quoted text and are labelled ordinary text.
comentario.comentario: comment: up to the end of the line

compilar-nativo.descripcion: The intermediate representation feeds two paths: the virtual machine and native code. An equals sign between them shows they give the same run.

concatenar.descripcion: Three boxes, "Hola, ", "Ana" and '!', with arrows converging on a larger box with "Hola, Ana!".

constante-sustituye.descripcion: A declaration of the constant SEMANA as 7 * 24 that is computed as 168. The line Write base, SEMANA becomes Write base, 168. Only base appears in memory; the constant has no box.

convenciones.descripcion: Three stacked examples. A code pill with the word If; a dashed slot with the word condition; and a program block with a title, a line number, a Write instruction and, below, a band with the output.

conversiones.titulo: Back and forth between text and number
conversiones.descripcion: At the top, the text "42" becomes a number with toInteger and comes back with toText. Below, the text "doce" cannot be converted and toInteger fails.

cortocircuito.descripcion: At the top, False And a crossed-out division by zero: the result is False without computing the right side. Below, True Or the same division: the result is True.

declarar-antes.descripcion: A Define total As Integer line creates an empty box named total. Below, the assignment total gets 10 stores a value in that box. A note recalls that assigning to an undeclared name is an error.
declarar-antes.prohibido: Assigning to a name without Define: error

designadores.descripcion: On the left, three designators: x, notas[i] and persona.nombre. On the right, three expressions that are not: 5, x + 1 and length(t).
designadores.nota: Values can only be stored in a place

determinismo.descripcion: A box with seed 42 from which two runs leave. Both produce the sequence 1, 1, 6 and an equals sign joins them.

diccionario.descripcion: Two columns, keys and values. The key Ana points to the value 13, marked as replaced; the key Luis points to 11. A note explains that keys keep the order in which they were inserted.
diccionario.nota: Keys stay in the order they came in

diferir-pila.descripcion: A stack: first cierro la puerta goes in and apago la luz on top. On leaving, apago la luz runs first and then cierro la puerta.

ecosistema.titulo: One language, one engine, three doors
ecosistema.descripcion: At the top, the PseudoLearn language in Spanish and English. Below, the engine that analyses and runs. Three arrows leave the engine towards the app, the command line and the web.

edicion.descripcion: A frame titled 2026 edition with three boxes: a single grammar, a single type policy and a fixed prelude with examples of built-in functions.

enumerado.descripcion: A box with the type Semaforo and its three members: Rojo, Amarillo and Verde. A variable luz, outside the box, points to the member Verde.

error-lexico.descripcion: A Write statement with an at sign between two texts. The at sign is marked in red and an arrow joins it to the diagnostic unrecognizedCharacter. Another arrow shows that the engine keeps reading; a dashed box recalls that no semantic analysis is done.
error-lexico.nota: No values are invented and nothing runs

escalera-precedencia.descripcion: Nine steps from top to bottom: postfix; sign and Not; power; product, division, div and mod; sum, subtraction and concatenation; order; equality; And; Or. Unary operators and power associate to the right.

espacios.descripcion: Two boxes with the same If. The top one has tidy indentation; the bottom one, messy spaces. Below, an equals sign marks that they mean the same.
espacios.igual: = the same program for the engine

estructura-archivo.descripcion: A file with four sibling units one under the other: the constant SALUDO, the enumeration Color, the algorithm Tienda, highlighted as the only one, and the subroutine Precio.

familias-biblioteca.descripcion: Two columns. On the left, the families that only compute: text, numbers, collections, JSON and bytes. On the right, those that need a capability: input and output, time, network and tasks.

familias-palabras.descripcion: Six coloured bands: program structure, subroutines, objects, types, boolean values and operators written with letters, each with examples.
familias-palabras.nota: The full list is in Appendix B

fecha-hora.descripcion: A DateTime joins an instant in nanoseconds since 1970 and an offset of +3600 seconds. Together they give the local time 2026-11-07T18:30:00+01:00.

generico.descripcion: At the top, the template Caja with a type slot T. Two arrows lead to two concrete versions, Caja of Integer and Caja of String.
generico.nota: A single definition; one version per type used

herencia-despacho.descripcion: The class Animal with Sonido and Presentarse, and below it Perro, which inherits from Animal and redefines Sonido. The object Toby is a Perro: the search for Sonido starts in Perro.
herencia-despacho.busca: Sonido is looked up in Perro

higiene.descripcion: A table with three variables. usada is written and read. olvidada is neither written nor read. escrita is written but not read.

http-ida-vuelta.descripcion: The program sends a GET request to the server and receives a 200 response with its body. Responses, including 404 and 500, are Success; transport failures are Error.

identificadores.descripcion: Two boxes joined by an arrow: the first character, which may be a letter, ñ, an accented vowel or an underscore, and the following ones, which also accept digits and may repeat. Below, four valid names in green and three invalid ones in red.
identificadores.inicio-ej: a–z A–Z ñ á é í ó ú ü _

instantanea.descripcion: The vector notas held a 7 when the snapshot was taken; a 9 was added afterwards. The picture, with a padlock, keeps only the 7: it can be read but not written.
instantanea.nota: The picture was taken before adding the 9

intercambio.descripcion: Three boxes a, b and auxiliar. a is 1 and b is 2. First auxiliar receives 1, then a receives 2 and finally b receives 1 from auxiliar.

interfaz-promesa.descripcion: The interface Figura with the method Area. The classes Cuadrado and Circulo realize it. Below, Describir with the parameter T: Figura, which accepts both.

json-arbol.descripcion: An object with three fields: nombre with "Ana", edad with 15 and notas with an array of 7 and 9. field("edad") goes down to 15.

leer-escribir.descripcion: The input holds 3 and 4. Read stores them in a and b. Write shows 3 + 4 = 7 on the output.
leer-escribir.nota: Read asks for one value per target, in order

leer-figura.descripcion: Three stacked instructions joined by arrows: total gets 0, total gets total plus 5, and Write total. Below, a box with the name total and its value. Each step highlights the instruction being run and the value changes from 0 to 5.

leer-raíles.titulo: How to follow a syntax diagram
leer-raíles.descripcion: Three strips of track. The first runs straight through the word While and the slot expression. The second has a detour that goes down to Else and back up, so Else can be skipped. The third passes through the slot statement and has a loop underneath back to the start, so the statement can be repeated.
leer-raíles.fijo: Fixed stretch: follow all of it
leer-raíles.se-salta: straight track: without the optional part

limites-recursos.descripcion: Four bars: depth, full and marked as exhausted; cells, statements and time, partly full.
limites-recursos.nota: caps are set by the host

literales-numericos.descripcion: Three rows. Integers: 0, 42 and 2026. Reals: 3.14, 0.5 and 100.0. Not numbers: point 5, 5 point, 3 comma 5, scientific notation and 1 underscore 000.

llamada-marcos.descripcion: A stack with the Principal frame at the bottom. Calling Doble pushes a frame with n = 21; on return it disappears and the value 42 goes down to Principal.

mapa-partes.descripcion: A diagram of stacked boxes. At the top Part 0 on how to read and Part I with the overview. Below, in two columns, lexical structure and types; then expressions and declarations; then control flow; then subroutines and objects. At the bottom a band with programs, errors, concurrency, library and engine, and another with the appendices.

mientras-ciclo.descripcion: A diamond with the condition n > 0. If it is true the body runs and control returns to the diamond; if it is false the loop is left towards EndWhile. Beside it, the value of n goes down from 3 to 0.

niveles.descripcion: Two columns. Before running, shape, names, types and called subroutines are checked. When running, division by zero, indices, variables without a value and overflow are checked.
niveles.nota: What can be known without running is checked beforehand

nuevo-pasos.descripcion: The variable pasos starts empty. An object with the attribute valor is reserved, the constructor gives it 10 and finally pasos receives the reference to the object.

opcional-resultado.descripcion: Two columns. Optional can be Some with a value or None. Result can be Success with a value or Failure with a reason. Below, a note says both cases must be considered with Switch, and that Propagate passes the error upwards.
opcional-resultado.regla: Before using the value, consider both cases
opcional-resultado.propagar: or Propagate: the error leaves the subroutine

orden-texto.descripcion: A line with upper-case A and Z on the left, with codes 65 and 90, and lower-case a and z on the right, with codes 97 and 122.

paquete-modulos.descripcion: A package called tienda with the module principal, which is the entry and holds the algorithm, and the module formas.geometria, with the public subroutine AreaCirculo and the private Ayudante. An import arrow goes from principal to geometria.

para-cada-recorrido.descripcion: A vector with pan, leche and huevos at positions 0, 1 and 2. A frame moves through each cell and producto takes the value of the framed cell.

para-contador.descripcion: A line with the values 1 to 6. The control starts at 1 and moves one by one; 5, the final value, is still included; on reaching 6 the loop ends.

paso-valor.descripcion: On the left, the main frame with x equal to 5. In the first step, Copia receives a box n with a copy that becomes 6 without changing x. In the second, Incrementar receives an arrow to x, which becomes 6.

perfiles-espejo.titulo: The same program in two profiles
perfiles-espejo.descripcion: Two columns, Spanish on the left and English on the right. Each row pairs a word: Si with If, Entonces with Then, Cadena with String. The last two rows show that the name nombre and the text Hola do not change.

posiciones.descripcion: A three-line program on a grid with line numbers on the left and column numbers above. On the second line the x of Write x is highlighted in red, and an arrow joins it to a note explaining that the span starts at line 2, column 12.

potencia-derecha.descripcion: The expression 2 ^ 3 ^ 2 with an arc under 3 ^ 2 showing it is computed first. Below, the result 2 ^ 9 = 512.
potencia-derecha.nota: The other operators group from left to right

punto-y-coma.descripcion: A While block with two statements inside. The two simple statements have a semicolon marked in green; the opening and closing lines have none, marked with an empty-set symbol in red.

pureza-grafo.descripcion: Principal calls the function Triple, which calls Avisar, which uses Write. The effect of Write climbs up to Triple, marked as an error.

receptor-este.descripcion: The variable pasos and, inside the method, This: both are references pointing to the same object, with valor = 12.

recursion-pila.descripcion: Four frames stacked from Factorial(4) to Factorial(1). The base case returns 1 and every frame multiplies: 2, 6 and 24.

redondeos.descripcion: A line with -3, -2 and -1 and the point -2.5. floor and round take it to -3; ceil and trunc take it to -2.
redondeos.nota: round takes ties away from zero

referencia-salida.descripcion: On the left, the main boxes c and r with 3 and 2. On the right, Dividir with cociente and resto, which are arrows to c and r.

registro-copia.descripcion: Two cards, a and b, with the fields fila and columna. Both had fila 1 and columna 2; after changing b.fila to 10, only b shows 10 and a still has 1.
registro-copia.separado: afterwards, each card changes on its own

regla-reales.descripcion: A horizontal ruler with separate marks. The literal 0.3 points at one mark; the result of 0.1 plus 0.2 points at the neighbouring mark, 0.30000000000000004.
regla-reales.nota: There is no Real between two marks
regla-reales.nota2: The marks are very close, but they never touch

reparto.descripcion: Seven circles: three for the first person, three for the second and one left over, highlighted. Below, the three operations: 7 / 2 = 3.5, 7 div 2 = 3 and 7 mod 2 = 1.

repetir-ciclo.descripcion: On the left, While: first the question and then the body, which can run zero times. On the right, Repeat: first the body and then the question; with False it repeats and with True it leaves, so the body runs at least once.

retornar-salidas.descripcion: Three Returns. The first If is false; the second holds and b, which is -2, is returned. The last Return is never reached.

salir-corte.descripcion: Five cells with 7, 14, 21, 28 and 35. 7, 14 and 21 are visited; at 21 a red line marks Exit and cells 28 and 35 are never visited.

segun-ramas.descripcion: A Switch on dia with three branches: 1 to 5 school day, 6 and 7 weekend, and Otherwise. The selector is 6 and only the second branch is followed down to EndSwitch.

semilla.descripcion: Two runs with the same seed draw the same sequence 1, 1, 6, 15. A run with seed 7 draws a different one.

severidad-clases.descripcion: At the top, the four classes in order: lexical, syntactic and semantic before running, and runtime during. Below, the four severity letters: A error, C hygiene, D information and E reading.

si-ordinograma.descripcion: A flowchart with the start, the assignment of estatura, a diamond asking whether estatura is greater than or equal to 120, two boxes with the Write of each branch, the point where they join and the end. Each step highlights the part being run.

sincronizacion.descripcion: Four lines. The first and third have an error and a mark that jumps to the next safe point; the second and fourth are recognised as usual.
sincronizacion.nota: one main error per broken statement

subcadena-posiciones.descripcion: The text Hola, mundo in cells numbered from 0 to 10. The first four, from 0 to 3, are highlighted as the result of substring(t, 0, 3).

subprograma-caja.descripcion: A box called Doble. The argument 21 goes in on the left and the result 42 comes out on the right.
subprograma-caja.dentro: the inside is not visible from outside

terminaciones.descripcion: At the top, the running state. An arrow goes down to a box with the four final terminations: completed, failed, cancelled and limit_reached. Two side arrows lead to the pauses awaiting_input and awaiting_effect, which resume.
terminaciones.pausas: Pauses: once the data arrives, they run again

tipo-resultado.descripcion: At the top, Integer plus Integer gives Integer. Below, Integer times Real gives Real.
tipo-resultado.nota: Two integers: an exact integer result

tipos-cajas.descripcion: Five boxes. Integer with the value 42; Real with 3.14; Boolean with its two values, True and False; Character with a single letter L; and String with the letters of Lucía in five boxes numbered 0 to 4.

traza-pasos.descripcion: A line with five events: enter, decision, write, exit and end. An arc between two events marks a step. Below, a state change: n = 3.

tres-trabajos.descripcion: A program with three arrows leaving it towards Analyse, Run and Observe. Below each one, what it produces: diagnostics, colours and help; output, termination and failures; trace, memory and timeline. A green line joins Run and Observe because both go through the instructions.

variante-formas.descripcion: A box with the type Forma and its three alternatives drawn: a circle, a rectangle and a point. Below, Switch f Do distributes the value into three branches, one per alternative.

vector-crece.descripcion: A dashed box representing the vector lista, with positions numbered 0, 1 and 2. Stepping forward, pan and leche appear; then fruta at the start, shifting the others; finally pan disappears and leche moves to position 1.

viaje.titulo: The five stages of the engine
viaje.descripcion: A column of boxes joined by arrows: the source text, lexical analysis, syntax analysis, semantic analysis, translation and execution. A dashed red line next to the first three marks that they form the analysis. Each step highlights one stage.

ruta-ciclo.descripcion: Five steps in a circle: Understand, Plan, Write, Test and Improve, joined by solid arrows. A red dashed arrow goes back from Test to Plan when something failed, and another dashed arrow goes from Improve to Understand, towards the next problem.
ruta-ciclo.vuelta: A failure does not start from scratch

ruta-instrucciones-en-orden.descripcion: On the left, a program with three Write instructions; on the right, the output. Each step highlights one instruction and its line appears in the output: first Hola, then 5 and finally 2 + 3.

ruta-caja-no-se-recalcula.titulo: A box does not recompute itself
ruta-caja-no-se-recalcula.descripcion: Two boxes, guests and portions. At first they hold 23 and 69. When guests changes to 30, portions stays at 69, marked in red. Only when the calculation runs again does portions become 90.

ruta-ficha.descripcion: A card with four zones for the tip problem: the bill and the number of friends go in; what each one pays comes out; the relation says how the total is computed and shared; the worked examples are 120 and 4 giving 33, 100 and 3 giving 37, and 100 and 1 giving 110.
ruta-ficha.relacion-1: bill plus a tenth, shared among friends, rounded up

ruta-tres-errores.descripcion: A bus trip from departure to destination. Step 1: the bus does not start, like a compile error, which the engine reports before starting. Step 2: the bus breaks down on the way, like a runtime error, which the engine reports when it happens. Step 3: the bus arrives in another town, like a logic error, which only your test cases reveal.

ruta-recta-casos.descripcion: A number line with the number of friends from -1 to 5, split into three zones: odd for 0 and negatives, edge at 1, and normal from 2 upwards. One point is marked in each zone: 0, 1 and 4.
ruta-recta-casos.pie: number of friends: one case per zone

ruta-particion-edad.descripcion: A line of ages from 0 to 100 split into two regions: those who pay 5, up to 11, and those who pay 8, from 12. A red line marks the edge between 11 and 12, with a point on each side.

ruta-dedo-decision.descripcion: The cinema program with a triangle pointing at the current instruction. The age is declared, 30 is read, the condition is false, the finger skips the Then branch, which is dimmed, and reaches the Write of Else, which shows Paga 8.

ruta-tabla-decision-bisiesto.descripcion: A table with three rows of questions, whether the year divides by 4, by 100 and by 400, and four columns of examples: 2023, 2024, 1900 and 2000. The last row gives the result: no, yes, no and yes.

ruta-orden-preguntas.descripcion: Two funnels for the year 1900. In the first one it only asks whether it divides by 4, the answer is yes and 1900 comes out as a leap year, which is wrong. In the second it asks by 400 first, then by 100, and 1900 comes out as not a leap year, which is right.

ruta-tabla-por-vuelta.descripcion: On the left, the three boxes of the money box: day, what is saved today and the total. On the right, a table that gains a row per step: before the loop 1, 2 and 2; the first pass 2, 3 and 5; the second 3, 4 and 9; and the eighth 9, 10 and 54, when the loop ends.

ruta-rol-contador.descripcion: Three steps growing by one, labelled counter.
ruta-rol-contador.frase: moves the same amount every pass

ruta-rol-acumulador.descripcion: A money box receiving a coin, labelled accumulator.

ruta-rol-bandera.descripcion: A pennant that goes up once and never comes down, labelled flag.
ruta-rol-bandera.frase: changes once and remembers that something happened

ruta-rol-mejor-hasta-ahora.descripcion: A podium with a single place and an arrow that replaces whoever holds it, labelled best so far.

ruta-elegir-bucle.descripcion: A tree of two questions. If you know how many passes there will be, For goes. Otherwise, you ask whether the first pass always happens: if it does, Repeat; if not, While.
ruta-elegir-bucle.cuantas: Do you know how many passes?
ruta-elegir-bucle.primera: Does the first pass always happen?

ruta-rol-recorredor.descripcion: A row of cells with an arrow under one of them, labelled walker.

ruta-dos-pasadas.descripcion: The array of temperatures 20, 23, 19, 25, 22, 18 and 26. First step: an arrow walks through all of it and feeds the average, 21.86. Second step: the cells above the average are marked: 23, 25, 22 and 26.

ruta-rol-seguidor.descripcion: Two footprints: the one behind follows the one in front, labelled follower.
ruta-rol-seguidor.frase: remembers the previous one to compare

ruta-esquemas.descripcion: The same array of seven temperatures drawn six times. Walking visits them all; counting marks the ones that meet a condition and gives a number; accumulating gathers them all into a total; searching marks up to the first one that meets it and stops; filtering keeps the ones that meet it in another array; transforming changes each one and gives another array of the same length.
ruta-esquemas.buscar-da: stops at the first that meets it
ruta-esquemas.transformar-da: gives a collection of the same length

ruta-racha.descripcion: Fourteen temperatures in a row and, below, the value of the streak day by day: it goes up with each day above 30 and goes back to 0 when it breaks. The streak reaches 3 in the first days, the first wave, and 4 between days 8 and 11, the second and longest wave. The last streak, of 2 days, ends with the data.
ruta-racha.final: The last streak is checked after the loop

ruta-matriz-coordenadas.descripcion: A 3 by 3 board with the row and the column written in each cell, from [0, 0] to [2, 2]. The two diagonals are highlighted: the one where the row equals the column and the one where row plus column equals 2.

ruta-busqueda-binaria.descripcion: A sorted array of fifteen numbers, from 2 to 44 in steps of three, where 26 is searched for. At each step the middle one is looked at and the half that cannot hold it is crossed out: first 23, then 35, then 29, and on the fourth step 26 appears.
ruta-busqueda-binaria.paso-1: 23 is smaller: cross out the left
ruta-busqueda-binaria.paso-2: 35 is greater: cross out the right
ruta-busqueda-binaria.paso-3: 29 is greater: cross out the right

ruta-pasos-crecen.descripcion: Horizontal bars with the steps each strategy needs in the worst case. With 10 values, one by one takes 10 and by halves 4; with 100, 100 and 7; with 1000, 1000 and 10.

ruta-seleccion.descripcion: Five numbers, 5, 3, 8, 1 and 9. At each step the smallest of the unsorted part moves to the front and is marked as sorted: first 1, then 3, which was already in place, then 5 and 8. 9 stays last.

ruta-arbol-boletin.descripcion: A decomposition tree. At the top, the report card. Below, four branches: read the marks, compute the average, decide the status and find the best. In the last step, each branch shows what solves it: reading, the Promedio subprogram, the Estado subprogram and the best so far.

ruta-maquina-pura.titulo: A pure machine and one with doors
ruta-maquina-pura.descripcion: Two machines. The pure one has a single input, the data, and a single output, the result. The other also has side doors: through one it reads, through others it writes and changes things outside, without it showing in the call.
ruta-maquina-pura.pie: what does not go through the call is an effect
